description: This file contains functions related to controlling LEDs via the device tree and sysfs interface in a Linux environment, specifically for embedded systems or hardware that supports LED controls through sysfs and device tree nodes.

methods.name: get_dt_led_path
methods.description: Retrieves the device tree LED path for a given LED identifier.

methods.name: get_dt_led_color_func
methods.description: Determines the color or label of an LED based on its device tree node.

methods.name: get_dt_led
methods.description: Gets the label or name of an LED based on its device tree path.

methods.name: led_set_attr
methods.description: Sets an attribute of an LED through the sysfs interface.

methods.name: led_timer
methods.description: Configures an LED to produce a timing (blinking) behavior.

methods.name: status_led_restore_trigger
methods.description: Restores the default trigger for a status LED from its device tree setting.

methods.name: status_led_set_timer
methods.description: Sets a blinking timer on a status LED.

methods.name: status_led_set_heartbeat
methods.description: Sets the LED trigger to heartbeat mode.

methods.name: status_led_blink_slow
methods.description: Configures status LEDs to blink slowly.

methods.name: status_led_blink_fast
methods.description: Configures status LEDs to blink quickly.

methods.name: status_led_blink_preinit
methods.description: Configures status LEDs to blink pre-initialization pattern.

methods.name: status_led_blink_failsafe
methods.description: Configures status LEDs to blink in a failsafe pattern.

methods.name: status_led_blink_preinit_regular
methods.description: Configures status LEDs to blink in a regular pre-initialization pattern.
